case.name: Timberland + Sidewinder + Blood Gulch + Battle Creek

warnings: This rebuild regenerates collision, portals and lightmaps; original per-cluster weather/sound assignments and render-only decorations require separate review. Donor scenery is optional; campaign actors, scripts and gameplay objects are not imported.
UVs are projected from source render surfaces where available. Unmatched collision-only surfaces use generated planar UVs.
A compiled clearance test and successful boot do not replace a manual player walkthrough, including scenery collision at the entrances.

Compiled revision inherits its matching editable tags and a clear nonduplicated title
All compiled Battle Creek scenery placements resolve real source models
Compiled connected map loads actual scenery, embedded materials and lightmaps in the native viewer
Owned original Battle Creek MCC texture packs finish loading before the matched source view
